# Collin Taylor

I am a University of South Florida student with interests in **risk management, insurance, business analytics, and data-driven decision-making**. Through RMI 4226, I have been building practical experience using R, Quarto, data manipulation, visualization, and statistical analysis to understand risk and insurance problems.

I am especially interested in applying analytical tools to real business decisions and communicating results in a clear, professional way.
